name: System Monitor
author: hell0world
description: CPU, memory and temperature in the bar, with a history graph and top processes

barWidget.description: Live CPU and RAM usage (and optionally CPU temperature) in the bar. Click for a CPU history graph, memory/swap/temperature meters, load, uptime, the busiest processes and a button to open btop.

schema.label: Update every (seconds)
schema.description: How often to sample /proc. 1–10 seconds; higher is lighter on slow CPUs.

schema.label: Show RAM in the bar
schema.description: Adds memory usage beside CPU usage.

schema.label: Show temperature in the bar
schema.description: Adds the CPU package temperature, when a sensor exists.

schema.label: CPU warning at (%)
schema.description: Highlights the widget when CPU usage reaches this.

schema.label: Temperature warning at (°C)
schema.description: Highlights the widget when the CPU reaches this temperature.
